messages:
Sam: Heads up Hey folks, visiting partner (Liam O'Connor) arriving tomorrow at 10:00. He mentioned bringing a demo monitor. Can we pre-print a visitor badge and reserve a seat near the east lounge?
Frontdesk-Bot: Visitor registered: Liam O'Connor 026-03-10 10:00. ID required on arrival. Temp badge ready for print.
Mailroom: Large parcel for 'Liam O'Connor / PartnerCo' delivered today, label says "monitor + cables". It's in oversized locker 2. Do you want us to hold it till arrival or leave at hotdesk? :package:
Sam: Please hold in locker and tag with arrival time. Also, could someone snap a photo of the package and drop it here?
Mailroom: Photo uploaded to #people-ops (see thread attachment). Tag set: "Liam O'Connor 10:00 arrival hold".
Aisha: I'll reserve the east lounge seat and put out a welcome sticky. Jon, can you print the badge at 9:45 and drop it with the welcome note?
Jon: Yep, I'll be at front desk at 9:40, badge printed and stapled to the welcome sheet.
Sam: Thanks all. One tiny ask: if he needs a VGA dongle we'll loan one from supplies, flag here and Jon will bring it. :thumbsup:
Aisha: Noted. Bringing cereal bar + water too.
Frontdesk-Bot: Reminder scheduled: print visitor badge at 09:45 tomorrow.
Jon: Done. I'll also leave a quick note about WiFi + guest creds on the desk.
Sam: You're the best. :raised_hands:
